meta.title: 피싱 메일 3초 판별법
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (피싱 메일 3초 판별법, a security training video for a fictional company). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 피싱 메일 3초 판별법, a security training video for a fictional company
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: A whiteboard and four markers, as the brief says: board #FBFBF8, black #1E1F22 for most lines and words, red #D9392B for danger (the hook, the @, the circled tricks, 3초만), blue #2563C9 for checking, green #2E9E5B for safe (the shield, 보안팀으로 전달).
rationale.type: Nanum Pen Script, a Korean marker hand, 46-240 px, revealed left to right as if written, with the marker tip riding the edge.
rationale.motion: A whiteboard animation: one long board, a camera that travels between panels (dipping out a little as it goes), a hand holding a marker that draws every line at hand speed, moves to the next stroke, enters and leaves the frame; on the checks panel the camera follows each column and pulls back to show all three.
rationale.sound: Corporate at 112 BPM in C major (7 bars in 15 s, 14 in 30 s): strings and a broken piano figure, a light kit; minimal SFX: a drawon for each drawing, a swish for each camera move, a tick for each second of the stopwatch.
rationale.visuals: All code: the board with ghosts of erased marker, marker strokes and hatching, an envelope, a fishing hook, a chain link and magnifier, a clock, a phishing mail window, a shield, a stopwatch, and the hand (palm, fingers, thumb, cuff) holding the marker.
rationale.narration: Not recommended here: the reel is muted-first; a training version could add a voice.
